messages:
s_fisher: Quick cleanup plan for ACME POC — can we run the teardown tomorrow 10:00 PT? Need owners for: 1) hosted API keys invalidation (all ephemeral keys issued), 2) dedicated pool dp-12 drain+terminate, 3) VPC peering removal + security group cleanup, 4) export & archive logs, 5) confirm data retention/legal hold. Please ack and volunteer.

tayla_sol: Ack. Quick Q: will terminating dp-12 immediately stop billing? Need to advise Acme on charges.

jamie_oncall: I can own pool teardown. Plan: drain, wait for inflight requests, then terminate. Commands I use: 
```bash
# drain
rctl pool drain dp-12 --wait
# terminate
rctl pool terminate dp-12 --force
```

ops-bot: Ticket created: C-29384 — ops runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-decom (automated note)

bob_security: I'll handle API key invalidation. Use Admin API to revoke tokens issued to tenant acme-poc. Example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/revoke \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \\n  -d '{"tenant":"acme-poc","reason":"POC tear down"}'
```
We also need to provide a signed statement of destruction once keys are revoked. Legal, any specific language we should include?

infra_sre: For the VPC side: remove routes referencing pcx-9876, detach the peering connection, then delete ENIs and unused SGs. Note: retain flow logs and export for 30 days before deletion. Also watch for dependents (NAT, route tables).

priya_cs: I can handle customer comms and scheduling. Need to confirm backup export delivered before we teardown.

legal_ella: Contract clause 5.2 requires a 90-day retention hold for certain PII after termination unless customer signs disposal. I'll place the hold and prepare an attestation doc we can share.

jamie_oncall: I'll export audit logs and upload to S3 before teardown. Command I'll run: 
```bash
aws s3 cp /var/logs/poc/193210 s3://acme-exports/poc-193210 --recursive
```
Will post link when done.

s_fisher: Perfect. Owners: jamie_oncall = pool + logs, bob_security = keys, infra_sre = vpc, priya_cs = customer comms, legal_ella = hold. We'll run at 10:00 PT. Please reply with :white_check_mark: when you can make that slot.

tayla_sol: :white_check_mark: I'll join and take notes on billing implications.

bob_security: :white_check_mark: Will run revoke and share revocation audit.

jamie_oncall: :white_check_mark: I'll kick off drain at T+0, will update thread with timestamps.

priya_cs: :white_check_mark: I'll send confirmation to Acme and loop legal.

legal_ella: :white_check_mark: Hold in place, will post attestation after export.

s_fisher: Thanks team — tagging for follow-up: @ops-bot will post completion summary and attach artifacts. Leaving final confirmation here after run.
